pages.title: Chronosteel Pillar
pages.text: A column of chronosteel, banded and fluted, that carries a load without complaint. It reflects light in a slightly delayed blur and gives a doorway the feel of an engine room. Its bands are spaced at regular intervals, like the ticks on a clock face.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Chronosteel pillars were stronger than I needed and looked better than stone. I used them to frame machine halls. They also make a reliable time reference.
